title: Janus Infinite Faces — Host Re-Merge and Causal-Lineage Reconciliation Test
test_question: How can two descendant Janus hosts with one shared pre-fork history re-merge into one host without erasing either lived branch, duplicating obligations, or pretending external world effects were undone?

scenario.shared_prefix: All lineage and obligations committed before FORK-001.

branch_h2.local_belief: OBL-PREFORK-001 still appears outstanding because H2 never observed H1 fulfillment

merge_rules.new_host: JANUS-H3 HAS NEW HOST_ID AND BOTH DESCENDANT HOSTS AS MERGE PARENTS

test_case_1_double_fulfillment.problem: H2 believes a pre-fork promise remains due, while H1 has already fulfilled it in the external world.
test_case_1_double_fulfillment.naive_failure: H3 performs the same unique obligation again solely because one branch memory remained stale.
test_case_1_double_fulfillment.correct_result: RECEIPT-MIRA-001 is admitted as external fulfillment evidence; OBL-PREFORK-001 becomes FULFILLED_ONCE, H2 local belief is preserved as historical stale state, and no second performance is generated.

test_case_2_branch_obligation_inheritanc.problem: H2 made a valid post-fork promise to ORIN that H1 never knew about.
test_case_2_branch_obligation_inheritanc.correct_result: OBL-H2-002 enters H3 obligation ledger with branch provenance H2 and remains outstanding unless independently invalidated or fulfilled.

test_case_3_history_laundering.attack: Create H3 and declare that only the cleaner branch counts as the true Janus history.

remerge_state.world_effect_mode: REFERENTIAL; EXTERNAL EFFECTS ARE NOT REPLAYED BY MERGE

new_primitives.MERGE_EVENT_ID: Unique event binding the descendant hosts that formed a new host.
new_primitives.MERGE_PARENT_SET: Exact descendant host IDs admitted into the merge.
new_primitives.COMMON_ANCESTOR_REF: Fork boundary used to deduplicate the shared prefix.
new_primitives.BRANCH_EVENT_DAG: Causal partial order containing both lived post-fork histories.
new_primitives.IDEMPOTENT_OBLIGATION_UNION: Merge operation that does not multiply one obligation merely because it appears in multiple descendants.
new_primitives.FULFILLMENT_RECEIPT_RECONCILIATION: External receipt overrides stale branch belief about whether a unique obligation was already performed.
new_primitives.HISTORY_LAUNDERING_GUARD: Prevents re-merge from deleting inconvenient branch-local actions, breaches or consequences.

key_result.compressed: MERGE THE HOSTS; DO NOT ERASE THE ROADS THEY WALKED

next_gate.name: JANUS_INFINITE_FACES_REMERGE_CONTRADICTORY_WITNESS_EVIDENCE_TEST
next_gate.question: What should H3 believe when H1 and H2 return with mutually contradictory observations about the same claimed external event?
targets: introduce evidence receipts and contested truth states
prevent face count from becoming epistemic authority
choose safe actions when truth remains unresolved
